evidence.title: Three years of Israel’s mass dispossession of West Bank Palestinians

occurrences.checkable_against: identity and household records for Jamal Mleihat
occurrences.quote_span: Jamal Mleihat, Alia’s 45-year-old uncle, sits with eight relatives nestled inside a bare concrete-block house on the ridge in al-Awsaj, with his daughter Sewar hanging off his lap.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities

occurrences.checkable_against: Israeli military raid records and West Bank incident records
occurrences.quote_span: Since October 7, the Israeli government has stepped up its raids on the occupied West Bank, while settlers have largely been given free rein to pursue a pogrom against Palestinians, with little pushback from within Israel.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities

occurrences.checkable_against: humanitarian displacement records and population records for Ras Ein al-Auja
occurrences.quote_span: Instead, its more than 600 Palestinian inhabitants experienced the largest single-community expulsion of Bedouins in the last three years, after repeated attacks by settlers from four surrounding outposts.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities

occurrences.checkable_against: humanitarian shelter and displacement records for al-Awsaj
occurrences.quote_span: The ridge itself is rock and dust, now home to about 25 families from al-Muarrajat, among others forcibly displaced in the past three years.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities

occurrences.checkable_against: testimony and humanitarian service records for the al-Muarrajat community
occurrences.quote_span: Before October 7 [2023 Hamas attack on Israel, and Israel’s subsequent genocidal war on Gaza], we were in the pastures – no harassment, we moved around freely,” said Jamal, a father of seven. “We had healthcare. We had a school. We had water in the same encampment.
occurrences.speaker: Jamal Mleihat
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities

occurrences.checkable_against: infrastructure inspection and utility records for Muhammad Ghawanmeh's shelter
occurrences.quote_span: His toilet does not work; he relies on water tanks and has almost no electricity.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities

occurrences.checkable_against: site inspection, drone footage and testimony from Muhammad Ghawanmeh
occurrences.quote_span: He built a fence around the house after recent settler attacks, and now faces constant drone surveillance from Israeli settlers.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities

occurrences.checkable_against: livestock and household interviews or humanitarian assessments for Muhammad Ghawanmeh
occurrences.quote_span: His flock has shrunk from about 300 to roughly 100 physically thinning sheep, which he now must buy fodder for, instead of letting them graze on the land, which he now says is largely forbidden by Israeli settlers and the army.
occurrences.speaker: Muhammad Ghawanmeh
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities

occurrences.checkable_against: school transportation records and attendance records for displaced families in al-Awsaj
occurrences.quote_span: There is no school bus; families pay for private transport, and “one day they study, one day they don’t, depending on the mood of the driver,” Jamal said.
occurrences.speaker: Jamal Mleihat
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities

occurrences.checkable_against: movement-restriction records and testimony from Muhammad Ghawanmeh
occurrences.quote_span: Today we can’t go 500 metres from the house.”
occurrences.speaker: Muhammad Ghawanmeh
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities

occurrences.checkable_against: satellite imagery and Israeli outpost records near Highway 90
occurrences.quote_span: A few hundred metres beyond Ghawanmeh’s fence, a white trailer and a few containers mark an Israeli outpost, established about six months ago on a hill overlooking Highway 90 and the displaced families along the ridge.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities

occurrences.checkable_against: Palestinian Authority school attendance and payroll records for al-Awsaj
occurrences.quote_span: “The government school is shut down today, no salaries,” Ghawanmeh said.
occurrences.speaker: Muhammad Ghawanmeh
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities

occurrences.checkable_against: Israeli government organizational records and appointments in the West Bank Settlement Administration
occurrences.quote_span: With Smotrich exercising broad powers over the West Bank through the Settlement Administration within the Ministry of Defence, and leaders in the Israeli West Bank military command increasingly coming from far-right, settler backgrounds themselves, Palestinians across the West Bank describe a deepening symbiosis of military, police, administration and settlers in exacting Palestinian dispossession.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities

occurrences.checkable_against: humanitarian coordinator assessments and population records for Ras Ein al-Auja
occurrences.quote_span: Ghawanmeh is from Ras Ein al-Auja, which had been the largest Bedouin community in the central Jordan Valley – so robust that humanitarian coordinators told Al Jazeera in October 2023 that the village’s displacement was unlikely.
occurrences.speaker: humanitarian coordinators
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities

occurrences.checkable_against: military movement-restriction orders and testimony from Muhammad Ghawanmeh
occurrences.quote_span: Two months ago, Ghawanmeh said, soldiers came to his house and told him he could no longer pass to the highway.
occurrences.speaker: Muhammad Ghawanmeh
occurrences.subject: West Bank Palestinian communities
